subject: r-inla error on linux: GLIBC_XX not found

messages.subject: r-inla error on linux: GLIBC_XX not found
parts:
Hi,

Using example code from documentation here, I am getting the errors shown below. I am trying to run this on a linux system (Linux 3.10.0-1160.31.1.el7.x86_64 x86_64). I have now upgraded to the testing version of R-INLA but I previously was using the stable version and the same thing happened. I am using R version 4.3.2.

--Fiona
